## Checklist
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run fmt:check` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has tests (runtime features in `packages/runtime/test`, syntax in a parser test that survives the printer round trip)
- [ ] Docs updated where writers will look (`docs/script-syntax.md`, `docs/theming.md`, …)
- [ ] A change to the script language or the compiled format has an entry in `docs/decisions.md`
- [ ] Error messages are written for writers and suggest the fix
